tokens.v: A narrow hard strip rakes along the hinge line from camera-left so the gap between lid and deck fills with one bright wedge of trapped light, brightest at the left end and dying to the right, the lid's leading edge a black blade cutting across it. That wedge is the subject. The lid was caught fifteen degrees off the base, still falling. 50mm at f/5.6, camera axis twelve degrees above a graphite seamless and level with the closing lid, three-quarters on from the front-left so the base's wedge taper and the slim full-width hinge bar keep their mass; a windowless studio after dark, that strip the only source, one soft bounce camera-right. Machined pale-silver aluminium, blank dark-grey keycaps, one large centred glass trackpad as a single unbroken pane in one seam, and a palm-rest front edge that is one clean chamfer carrying no tab, step or second panel. Hold the machine to two-thirds of the frame width. The base sits flat to the sweep, a hard contact shadow directly beneath it and no gap; the sweep runs out of the bottom edge and the side edges crop empty graphite.
